import json,os
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock,patch
from moto import mock_aws
import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
from careervp.dal.dynamo_dal_handler import DynamoDalHandler
from careervp.models.result import Result,ResultCode
def make(name,keys):
    return boto3.resource('dynamodb').create_table(TableName=name,KeySchema=[{'AttributeName':k,'KeyType':t} for k,t in zip(keys,['HASH','RANGE'])],AttributeDefinitions=[{'AttributeName':k,'AttributeType':'S'} for k in keys],BillingMode='PAY_PER_REQUEST')
with mock_aws():
    from careervp.handlers import cv_tailoring_handler as ct,cover_letter_handler as cl,vpr_status_handler as vs,cv_upload_handler as cu
    from careervp.logic import cv_parser as cp
    os.environ.update(DYNAMODB_TABLE_NAME='legacy',ARTIFACTS_TABLE_NAME='artifacts',CVS_TABLE_NAME='cvs',TABLE_NAME='legacy',CV_BUCKET_NAME='cv-bucket')
    legacy=make('legacy',['pk','sk']); art=make('artifacts',['applicationId','artifactId']); cvs=make('cvs',['userId','cvId'])
    router=Mock()
    for gpa in [3.5,None]:
        extracted={'full_name':'Test','education':[{'institution':'School','degree':'BSc','gpa':gpa}],'user_id':'victim'}
        router.invoke.return_value=Result(success=True,data={'text':json.dumps(extracted)},code=ResultCode.SUCCESS)
        with patch.object(cp,'get_llm_router',return_value=router):
            parsed=cp.parse_cv('owner',cv_text='Experienced software engineer Python AWS and data architecture. '*5)
        assert parsed.success and parsed.data.education[0].gpa is None and parsed.data.user_id=='owner'
        DynamoDalHandler('cvs').save_cv(parsed.data)
        print('S11d real parser:',json.dumps({'LLM_GPA':gpa,'model_GPA':parsed.data.education[0].gpa,'persisted':True,'owner':parsed.data.user_id}))
    for fails in [True,False]:
        repo=Mock();repo.get_job.return_value={'job_id':'j','user_id':'owner','status':'PROCESSING','application_id':'a'}
        repo.update_job_status.return_value=Result(success=not fails,data=None,code=ResultCode.DYNAMODB_ERROR if fails else ResultCode.SUCCESS)
        sfn=Mock();apps=Mock()
        if fails:
            sfn.stop_execution.side_effect=RuntimeError('stop denied')
            apps.update_chain_execution_status.side_effect=RuntimeError('write denied')
            apps.update_artifact_status.side_effect=RuntimeError('write denied')
        with patch.object(vs,'_try_stop_chain_for_job',side_effect=lambda job,uid:vs._do_stop_chain(sfn,apps,'arn','a',uid,{'vpr':'processing'})):
            r=vs._handle_vpr_cancel({'pathParameters':{'vprId':'j'}},repo,'owner')
        assert r['statusCode']==200
        print('S10:',json.dumps({'all_effects_fail':fails,'http':r['statusCode'],'stop_attempted':sfn.stop_execution.call_count,'job_result_checked':False}))
    for kind,t,keys,prefix,handler,event in [('cover',art,['applicationId','artifactId'],'ARTIFACT#COVER_LETTER#',cl._handle_cover_letter_cancel,{'pathParameters':{'coverLetterId':'j'}}),('tailor',legacy,['pk','sk'],'ARTIFACT#CV_TAILORED#',None,{'pathParameters':{'cvTailoringId':'j'}})]:
        key=dict(zip(keys,['owner',prefix+'j']))
        for race in [False,True]:
            t.put_item(Item={**key,'status':'PROCESSING','payload':'REAL'})
            original=t.update_item
            def update(**kw):
                if race: t.delete_item(Key=key)
                return original(**kw)
            with patch('boto3.resource',return_value=SimpleNamespace(Table=lambda name:t)),patch.object(t,'update_item',side_effect=update) as write:
                r=handler(event,'owner') if kind=='cover' else ct._handle_cv_tailoring_cancel(event,'owner',{})
            row=t.get_item(Key=key)['Item']
            assert r['statusCode']==200 and row['status']=='CANCELLED' and ('payload' in row) is (not race)
            assert 'ConditionExpression' not in write.call_args.kwargs
            assert set(write.call_args.kwargs['Key'])==set(keys)
            print('S11:',json.dumps({'kind':kind,'delete_between_read_write':race,'key_names':keys,'partial_upsert': 'payload' not in row,'http':r['statusCode']}))
    for kind,t,keys,prefix in [('cover',art,['applicationId','artifactId'],'ARTIFACT#COVER_LETTER#'),('tailor',legacy,['pk','sk'],'ARTIFACT#CV_TAILORED#')]:
        for size in [10,220000]:
            for i in range(6): t.put_item(Item={keys[0]:'page-owner',keys[1]:prefix+str(i),'payload':'x'*size})
            with patch.object(DynamoDalHandler,'_get_db_handler',return_value=t),patch.object(t,'query',wraps=t.query) as query:
                rows=cl._list_cover_letter_items('page-owner') if kind=='cover' else ct._list_tailored_cv_items('page-owner')
            assert len(rows)==6 and query.call_count==(2 if size>100 else 1)
            if size>100: assert 'ExclusiveStartKey' in query.call_args.kwargs
            print('G4:',json.dumps({'kind':kind,'bytes_per_row':size,'rows':len(rows),'query_calls':query.call_count}))
print('BATCH3 ALL ASSERTIONS PASSED')
